summary: A fake CoinPoker support account contacted the user by Reddit DM after a public support request and directed them to a fraudulent DApp site. The user entered a recovery phrase and attackers drained about 2000 dollars in crypto from the wallet.
user_mistake: entered recovery phrase into site provided by unsolicited support account
prevention: Enter recovery phrases only during wallet recovery in the official wallet application / Use support channels linked directly from the official service
